svg.text: Tags at the right edge with the same name are the same net.
MQ-7: Q1/Q2 PWM-switch the 5 V heater supply (28 % duty ≈ 1.4 V measure).
DC_IN+ = wall adapter output, PACK+ = 2S pack, +5V = buck output.
UART: ESP32 RX pin ← module TX; ESP32 TX pin → module RX.
Sensor/ADC pins on ADC1 only (ADC2 conflicts with Wi-Fi).
